notes: New: More shapes to draw, including triangle, diamond, pentagon, hexagon, star, heart, plus, block arrow, chevron, check mark, cross and rounded box.
New: An eraser tool that rubs out your marks. Press E to pick it.
New: The eraser shows as a circle the size it erases. Set its size with the slider next to the tool.
New: Hold Shift and scroll over the picture to change the size of the pen, highlighter, shapes, eraser or text. A small preview shows the size as you go.
Improved: The first-snap instructions and the New snap tooltip now show the shortcut keys you chose.
